# Wall-time budgets, in seconds, for each labeled verification stage on the
# hosted runners: ubuntu-24.04 (linux) and macos-14 (macos). `run-check.pl`
# reads this table; CI sets WHITEFOOT_TIME_BUDGETS=enforce, so a stage over its
# budget, or one without a row for its host, fails the job after every stage has
# run. A local run only prints the comparison.
#
# A budget is about 1.5 times the slowest of the recent runs measured in
# research/investigations/test-economy/time-budgets.md, rounded up, and never
# under 10 s. Raise one only with the owner's approval, as a decision in the
# handoff; lower one in the change that makes its stage faster. "-" marks a
# stage that does not run on that host.

label                           linux  macos  windows

# gate.yml, static group
check/static                    120    120    -
repository-invariants           25     25     -
spec-archives                   10     10     -
readme-translation              10     10     -
spec-prose-integrity            10     10     -
guidance                        10     10     -
source-size                     10     10     -
design-lint                     10     15     -
conformance                     10     10     -
performance-instrument          10     10     -
compiler/lint                   90     90     -

# gate.yml, unit group: the library in test mode, then its cases
check/unit                      280    350    -
compiler/test-build-unit        155    240    -
compiler/test-unit              130    110    -

# gate.yml, corpus group: the ordinary library, the CLI and corpus harnesses,
# then their cases
check/corpus                    250    270    -
compiler/test-build-corpus      125    150    -
compiler/test-corpus            130    120    -

# gate.yml, runtime group
check/runtime                   25     20     -

# io-hosts.yml, completion-linux
linux-runtime                   50     -      -
linux-asan-ubsan                15     -      -
linux-default-tsan              10     -      -
linux-deque-tsan                10     -      -
linux-runtime-tsan              10     -      -

# compute-regression.yml: two cold compiler builds at two Cargo jobs, their
# images, then the host control, the instrument's slowdown control and the
# paired comparison
performance-candidate-compiler  150    -      -
performance-baseline-compiler   150    -      -

performance-baseline-images     30     -      -
